name: Form: Open

description.en: Open a prefilled public form, edit the fields, and submit it.
description.de: Oeffnet ein vorausgefuelltes oeffentliches Formular, Felder bearbeiten und absenden.
description.fr: Ouvrez un formulaire public pre-rempli, modifiez les champs et envoyez-le.
description.es: Abre un formulario publico precargado, edita los campos y envialo.
description.ro: Deschide un formular public precompletat, editeaza campurile si trimite-l.
description.it: Open a prefilled public form, edit the fields, and submit it.

bot: Open a form app for a public JoAi form. Collect the known field values in chat and pass them as `values`; the user can edit everything before submitting. Get the form id from the city or business data. The app submits through form-submit.

inputs.name: Form ID
inputs.bot: The public form id, for example private_GjJZrBARQKpn.
